mapper.update: update tb_user_search_history set is_deleted = 1,update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() where user_id=#{userId} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT keyword FROM tb_user_search_history WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND keyword IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(keyword) <> '' GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(COALESCE(update_time, create_time)) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
